verdict.rationale: NetHunt CRM is a SaaS CRM that connects to AI assistants, so a training opt-out or no-training data policy is a fair question for it. The evidence pack has no policy, setting, or contractual commitment about excluding customer data from AI model training. The llms.txt probe only covers crawler access to public site pages, not user data, so it earns no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can prevent my data from being used to train AI models
